# react-tiny-state

> A super simple React state management library (npm: `@jswork/react-tiny-state`) built on `React.createContext` + `useReducer`. It provides modular stores with `state` / `getters` / `actions` / `watch`, nested-path read/write (`nx.$get` / `nx.$set`), and global methods (`nx.$call`, `nx.$use`) with no dependencies beyond `@jswork/next`.

The library attaches a global API onto `nx` (from `@jswork/next`): `nx.$defineStore` declares a store module, and `nx.$get` / `nx.$set` / `nx.$call` / `nx.$use` read, write, invoke, and consume state. The default export, `StateProvider`, merges module states into one root state and provides it through a React context so updates re-render consumers.

## Documentation

- [README.md](README.md): Full getting-started guide covering store modules, composing stores, wrapping the app, and the complete API reference

## Source

- [src/index.ts](src/index.ts): Core implementation — store definition, state proxying, `useReducer`-based provider, and the `nx` global API
- [src/global.d.ts](src/global.d.ts): Type declarations for `StoreDescriptor`, `StateProviderProps`, and the `NxStatic` interface
- [src/utils.ts](src/utils.ts): Inlined utility functions (`camelize`, `slice2str`, `invoke`) that replaced the `@jswork/next-camelize` / `next-slice2str` / `next-invoke` packages

## Examples

- [Store module example (theme)](docs/src/shared/stores/modules/theme.ts): Shows `nx.$defineStore` with `state` and `watch`
- [Store module example (user)](docs/src/shared/stores/modules/user.ts): Shows `nx.$defineStore` with `getters` and async `actions`
- [Stores composition](docs/src/shared/stores/index.ts): Globs and composes store modules via `import.meta.glob`
- [App wrapper usage](docs/src/App.tsx): Minimal React app wrapped with `StateProvider`
- [Component consumption](docs/src/comp1.tsx): Reads state inside a component with `nx.$get`
- [Tests](__tests__/index.spec.ts): Unit tests for the utils and API shape
